steps.title: Build the radio policy
steps.body: Run `enable` and `show policy-map interface g0/2`: one FIFO queue, thousands of drops. The class-maps VOICE, VIDEO and BULK already exist. In `conf t`: `policy-map RADIO-OUT`, then `class VOICE`, `priority percent 20`; `class VIDEO`, `bandwidth percent 30`; `class BULK`, `police 1000000 conform-action transmit exceed-action drop`; `class class-default`, `fair-queue`.

steps.title: Apply it where the queue forms
steps.body: The queue builds where traffic leaves onto the radio: `interface g0/2`, `service-policy output RADIO-OUT`. `end`, then `show policy-map interface g0/2`: voice has zero drops.

objectives.label: RADIO-OUT applied outbound on the radio

steps.title: Shape the Earth contract
steps.body: Gi0/3 is a 1 Gbps port on a 50 Mbps contract. In `conf t`: `policy-map SHAPE-EARTH`, `class class-default`, `shape average 50000000`, then `interface g0/3`, `service-policy output SHAPE-EARTH`. Then answer: for the BULK limit you used one tool, for Earth's contract the other. `submit BULK=police` or `shape`, and `submit EARTH=...`.
